## Definition of Done

- [ ] **Acceptance criteria:** All acceptance criteria of the linked issue are met.
- [ ] **Code quality:** The code works as intended and is readable. Where the intent is not obvious, it is commented.
- [ ] **Tests:** New logic (e.g. extraction, transformation, graph construction) is covered by tests. All tests pass locally and, where configured, in CI.
- [ ] **Documentation:** `README.md`, `docs/` and `AGENTS.md` reflect the change.
- [ ] **Data and secrets:** No credentials, API keys or raw data that may not be published are committed.
- [ ] **Peer review:** At least one other team member has approved the PR.
- [ ] **Linked issue:** The PR body contains `Closes #<issue-number>`.
